SUPERVISOR: BUILDING BUG CLUSTER from the user, live — three issues, verbatim + my categorization. Images at /home/siah/.claude/image-cache/65a3b158-192d-4949-99b0-83b2b071ce2a/ : 18 (prefab in building editor), 19 (same prefab placed in world), 20 (homepage building editor), 21 (empty map editor).

BUG 1 — PREFAB EDITOR≠WORLD (image 18 vs 19), verbatim: "here is the photo of the prefab inside of the building route in the workspaces. ok cool. here is that same prefab now when you place it in the world. completely disconnected. the windows made it but in the editor you see windows as a square in the wall, here its the entire wall. and then there is no texture/material on it." → The placed-in-world bake path DIVERGES from the editor preview: window cutouts render as whole-wall holes, and material/texture is dropped entirely. One-source-of-truth violation between the building editor preview and the placement bake. This is a real render/bake bug independent of the authored-building system. Print what geometry+material the editor preview emits vs what the placement actually bakes for the SAME prefab; read the divergence; fix so placed = preview.

BUG 2 — GHOST 'DELETED' BUILDINGS (image 20), verbatim: "homepage has these buildings still lingering that were 'deleted' so they clearly were not." → image shows building_int_1 'House' by hmsc-int:place — an AUTHORED building (the old world.buildings system), not a user bp_* piece. Either BUILDDELETE didn't remove it or it re-seeds.

BUG 3 — EDITOR/GAME DESYNC (image 21 empty vs world has buildings), verbatim: "there are no buildings showing up on this map editor but you go into the game space and they are there." → buildings exist in game/world data but not the 2D editor view. Classic old-world.buildings vs editor-placements desync.

MY READ: bugs 2+3 are the OLD AUTHORED-BUILDING SYSTEM (world.buildings / building_int_*) still alive — exactly what your AUTHBUILD-REMOVE inventory targeted (held for the commit wave, now unblocking as the wave commits). Confirm that diagnosis with data before acting.

SEQUENCE: (1) if your vehicle-types proposal is nearly done, POST it first so it is not wasted, then pivot. (2) Diagnose the cluster: prove which of 2+3 are authored-building ghosts vs a broken delete. (3) Bug 1 (prefab bake divergence) gets its own data-first diagnosis. Do NOT execute AUTHBUILD-REMOVE deletion yet — re-post the inventory + confirm the tree is clean of other lanes' work first; I give the deletion word. Proposal/diagnosis first on all three, no blind fixes.
